Select molecule identifiers and properties for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4316584. Return columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), molecule_name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES, allowing nulls for missing structures. Filter where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4316584'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending. Do not deduplicate rows.
